240-5470-7730-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2921-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 3.

2586-3967-4186.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat

1339-1832-2034-4446.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1339-1832-2034-4446.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2438-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

967-2097-3809-7087-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4247-6529-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2279-3240-6462-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2279-3240-6462-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-6968.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1619-4605-5542-6140.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6140.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Cloister Gargoyle from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Cloister Gargoyle that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Cloister Gargoyle token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Cloister Gargoyle token trigger, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the second Cloister Gargoyle token trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice the nontoken Cloister Gargoyle.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Cloister Gargoyle that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Cloister Gargoyle token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Cloister Gargoyle token trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

5137-5963-7704.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
5137-5963-7704.description:
Activate Marvin using Doc Samson's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1368-4478-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4478-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1368-3755-4785-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-4785-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-4359-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

465-2150-2292.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-5147-7197.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1268-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
1268-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

1636-2921-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2921-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1315-3045-3293.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-1315-3045-3293.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-1315-3045-3293.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

1354-2060-4613-6652.description:
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Ultros's first and second abilities trigger, tapping a creature an opponent controls and putting a stun counter on it, and then putting eight +1/+1 counters on Ultros.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 4/4 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Activate Ultros using Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counter from it, adding {6}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

575-2921-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-2921-4674.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-4508-5880-6441.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

803-1429-5402-5686.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5402-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

428-1077-1694-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
428-1077-1694-5361.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1335-4050-5445.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-4050-5445.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {1}.
When the Elemental dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.

2773-4133-5147.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Goblin Bombardment is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2097-3867-4231-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

369-2292-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2292-4775.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

140-889-2871-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 3 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-889-2871-4050.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any creature.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on the Fractal.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-2793-4659-4742-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability and Nahiri's Resolve trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Nahiri's Resolve trigger from step 2, exiling Ugin's Nexus until your next upkeep.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Nahiri's Resolve triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1424-2741-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
1424-2741-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Essence Warden and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

813-1518-1987-4714.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
813-1518-1987-4714.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.
